what: Contract addition to write up (Andrew 17:57, build explorer provenance), now in blaze_query::db: db/provenance.rs. Storage::provenance(&self, &mut Vec<Provenance>) is the current view's table of every memo that was not a plain hit: Provenance { node, key: DatabaseKeyIndex, outcome: Outcome (Verified | Reran | ReranSameOutput), cause: Option<Cause> }. Cause is Changed(node), the first read the claimed verify found changed, or New | Evicted | Untracked | Cycle. Storage::node_read(node) -> Read names a node. A run records one u64 per node (Storage::runs: view, reason, cause node), written once by the flight holder before it runs; a hit and a verify write nothing. Views are restamped with the colors when they are renumbered.
